name: W1 · The Cure (widescreen)
note: Widescreen sample (zombies are fiction): Dr. Hana walks the long subway tunnel, cures three dazed walkers one by one, and they all head for the exit together.

cues.text: Down the long subway tunnel, Dr. Hana carries her new cure. Three dazed walkers drift slowly towards her.
One gentle sparkling mist at a time. Nora, then her two friends, wake up as themselves again.
Together we walk out into the daylight. Science and kindness win!

name: W2 · Quiet Street (widescreen)
note: Widescreen sample (zombies are fiction): Mika and Leo hide behind an old bus, throw an empty can far down the long street to draw two walkers away, and slip back the way they came.

cues.text: Two dazed walkers drift down the long empty street. Mika and Leo crouch low behind an old bus.
Leo throws an empty can far down the street. The clatter draws both walkers away.
Stay quiet, stay together, always keep a way out. The team slips away safely.

name: W3 · The Tortoise and the Hare (widescreen)
note: Widescreen sample (Aesop's fable): on a long meadow track the hare dashes ahead and naps under a tree, while the tortoise keeps walking and reaches the finish first.

cues.text: The hare races far ahead, then lies down for a nap in the shade.
Slow and steady, step after step, the tortoise keeps going.
The tortoise crosses the finish line first. The two friends cheer together!

name: W4 · Castle Life (widescreen)
note: Widescreen sample (medieval, no fighting): the drawbridge comes down, a horse cart rolls across the whole yard, two friends practise with a wooden shield, then everyone walks to the village market.

cues.text: The drawbridge comes down and a horse cart full of vegetables rolls into the castle yard.
Under the banner, two friends practise holding a wooden shield, safely and with a smile.
Training done! Everyone walks down to the village market together.

name: W5 · Solar System Tour (widescreen)
note: Widescreen sample: a rocket flies across the wide frame past all eight planets in order, from Mercury to Neptune.

cues.text: Leaving the Sun behind, the rocket passes the rocky planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars.
Further out wait the giants: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.
